点盘子放入两片吐司，旋转旋钮选择喜欢的焦度。: Click the plate to load two slices. Turn the knob to choose browning.
点盘子放入两片新吐司: Click the plate to load two fresh slices
选择焦度后压下侧边手柄: Choose browning, then press the side lever
正在压下，点击手柄可取消: Lowering. Click the lever to cancel.
烘烤中，可按停止键或抬起手柄取消: Toasting. Press Stop or lift the lever to cancel.
请等吐司弹稳后领取: Wait for the toast to settle before collecting it
拿起两片吐司，对准双槽轻轻放入。: Lift two slices, align them with the slots and lower them gently.
吐司已放好。旋转旋钮选焦度，再压下侧边手柄。: Toast loaded. Choose browning, then press the side lever.
当前焦度已锁定。: Browning setting locked for this cycle.
手柄下压，吐司进入发热槽。: Lever lowering; toast enters the heating slots.
正在烘烤，发热丝亮起，吐司慢慢变色。再次点手柄可提前弹出。: Toasting. Elements glow and the bread browns gradually. Click the lever again to eject early.
叮！托架释放，吐司正在弹起。: Ding! The carrier releases and the toast rises.
已取消，当前焦度已保留。点击吐司领取。: Cancelled. Existing browning is kept. Click the toast to collect it.
吐司出炉，点击面包领取。: Toast ready. Click the bread to collect it.
发热丝已关闭，托架正在把吐司弹回槽口。: Elements off. The carrier is returning toast to the slots' tops.
把两片吐司从槽口取出，放回盘子。: Lift both slices out of the slots and return them to the plate.
已领取两片吐司！点盘子换上新面包，再烤一份。: Two slices collected! Click the plate for fresh bread and another cycle.
换上新吐司，再烤一份: Load fresh toast for another cycle
从盘子放入两片吐司: Load two slices from the plate
这是定时烘烤与弹起机构的简化示意，用时长代替温控过程；没有模拟或测量真实温度。: Simplified timed heating and pop-up mechanism. Duration stands in for temperature control; no real temperature is simulated or measured.
面包放入双槽后，压下手柄使托架下降。焦度旋钮在本示意中控制加热时长。: Load bread into both slots, then lower the lever and carrier. In this illustration, the browning knob controls heating duration.
面包先抬高再移到槽口，最后放入双槽；这时发热丝还未通电。: Bread lifts, moves above the slots and lowers into them. Heating remains off during loading.
焦度越深，示意加热时长越长。压下手柄后设定锁定，不能中途改变。: Darker browning uses a longer illustrated heating time. Pressing the lever locks the setting for this cycle.
手柄带动托架下降，面包进入发热槽。压到底才通电；再点手柄可提前释放。: The lever lowers the carrier into the heating slots. Power starts only at the bottom. Click the lever again for early release.
发热丝通电，电能转为热量。本示意按加热时长逐渐加深面包颜色，不把进度当作温度。: The powered elements convert electricity to heat. Colour deepens with heating time; progress is not temperature.
提前停止会立即断电，再释放托架；已经产生的焦度保留。: Early stop cuts power immediately, then releases the carrier. Existing browning is kept.
尚未加热就取消，发热丝不会通电；托架从当前位置回到槽口。: Cancelling before heating leaves the elements off. The carrier returns from its current position.
设定时长到达，发热丝先断电，再释放托架，让面包弹回槽口。: At the selected duration, power cuts first, then the carrier releases to return the toast.
托架已经回稳，发热丝保持断电。提前停止保留的颜色会随面包一起放回盘子。: The carrier has settled and heating stays off. Browning kept after early stop returns to the plate with the toast.
吐司已弹稳，发热丝保持断电。点击吐司，将烤好的两片取出。: Toast settled, elements off. Click to remove both toasted slices.
吐司抬离槽口后移到盘子；取出动作完成后才计入已领取片数。: Toast lifts out and moves to the plate. Collected slices count only when removal finishes.
放入新吐司 · 再观察一轮: Load fresh toast · observe another cycle
此示意同时改变加热时长与最终上色深浅；不代表真实温度。: This illustration changes both heating duration and final colour. It does not represent real temperature.
此时尚未加热；让托架从当前位置回到槽口。: Heating has not started. Return the carrier from its current position.
立即断电，并让托架从当前位置回升；保留已有上色。: Cut power immediately and raise the carrier, retaining existing browning.
取消当前动作并清空机内吐司；已领取片数和焦度设定保留。: Cancel the action and clear bread from the machine. Keep the collected-slice count and browning setting.

槽口已弹稳的两片吐司: Two settled slices at the slot tops
吐司移回盘子 · 完成后才增加领取数: Toast returns to the plate · count increases only on completion
看懂一步 · 烘烤与弹起: Follow one step · heating and pop-up
跟随当前动作，不设暂停关卡。焦度用时长与上色示意；没有模拟真实温度、温控器或传感: Follow the current action without pause gates. Browning uses time and colour; no real temperature, thermostat or sensors are simulated.
退出讲解 · 保留本轮进度: Leave explanation · keep this cycle's progress
放入吐司，旋转旋钮，压下手柄等待弹起: Load bread, turn the knob and lower the lever; wait for the pop.
发热丝把电能转为热量。烘烤结束，弹簧托架把面包送回槽口。: Elements convert electrical energy to heat. When toasting ends, the spring carrier returns the bread to the slot tops.
